快速 endpoint for the FLUX.1 Kontext [dev] model with LoRA 支持, enabling rapid and high-质量 图像 editing using pre-trained LoRA adaptations for specific styles, brand identities, and product-specific outputs.
flux, editing, 转换, 图生图, img2img, lora

acceleration.description: The 速度 of the 生成. The higher the 速度, the faster the 生成.

enable_safety_checker.description: 若设为 true，将启用安全检查器。

guidance_scale.description: CFG（无分类引导）系数，表示模型在寻找相关图像时对提示词的遵循程度。

image.description: The URL of the 图像 to edit. Max width: 14142px, Max height: 14142px, Timeout: 20s

loras.description: The LoRAs to use for the 图像 生成. You can use any number of LoRAs and they will be merged together to 生成 the final 图像.

num_inference_steps.description: 执行的推理步数。

prompt.description: The 提示词 to edit the 图像.

resolution_mode.description: Determines how the 输出 分辨率 is set for 图像 editing. - `auto`: The model selects an optimal 分辨率 from a predefined set that best matches the 输入 图像's 宽高比. This is the recommended setting for most use cases as it's what the model was trained on. - `match_input`: The model will attempt to use the same 分辨率 as the 输入 图像. The 分辨率 will be 调整 to be compatible with the model's requirements (e.g. dimensions must be multiples of 16 and within 支持 limits). Apart from these, a few aspect 比例 are also 支持.

seed.description: 相同种子与相同提示词在同一版本模型下，每次都会生成相同的图像。

sync_mode.description: 若为 `True`，媒体将以 data URI 形式返回，输出数据不会出现在请求历史中。

fal.image_to_image.SmartResize.title: Smart Resize
fal.image_to_image.SmartResize.description:
Smart 图像 resize to arbitrary dimensions, powered by Nano Banana Pro with vision-LLM-guided prompting for composition-aware recomposition. Crop, cropping, resize ads.
editing, 图生图, img2img, smart, resize

image.description: The URL of the source 图像 to resize.

num_images_per_size.description: The number of nano-banana-pro variants to 产生 for each target 尺寸. The response 图像 list will contain ``len(target_sizes) * num_images_per_size`` 图像 in total.

output_format.description: The 输出图像 格式.

prompt.description: 可选 extra instruction that is forwarded to nano-banana-pro alongside the auto-生成 resize 提示词. Leave empty to let the model preserve the original 图像 content as closely as possible.

resolution.description: Hint for the minimum 分辨率 tier to use internally. The smart-resize algorithm may pick a higher tier automatically when the requested target 尺寸 is too large for this tier. This field does not affect the final 输出 dimensions — those come from ``target_sizes``.

safety_tolerance.description: The 安全容忍度 level applied to the inner nano-banana-pro /edit calls. Higher numbers loosen 安全 filtering.

seed.description: 可选 随机种子 forwarded to the inner nano-banana-pro /edit calls for 可复现. The same 种子 is used for every target 尺寸 when set.

sync_mode.description: When True, the response contains data URIs in place of CDN URLs so the client can decode the 图像 without an extra HTTP request. 添加 latency for large outputs.

target_sizes.description: The list of target dimensions to 生成, each written as ``<width>x<height>`` (e.g. ``"1920x1080"``). One 输出图像 is produced per target 尺寸 (multiplied by ``num_images_per_size``). The endpoint internally picks the smallest nano-banana-pro preset that fully covers each target so the final 图像 is a pixel-perfect match with no 超分放大.

OpenAI's Whisper model for robust multilingual 语音 recognition.

audio.description: URL of the 音频 file to transcribe. 支持 格式: mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav or webm.

chunk_level.description: Level of the chunks to return. Either none, 分割 or word. `none` would imply that all of the 音频 will be transcribed without the timestamp tokens, we suggest to switch to `none` if you are not satisfied with the transcription 质量, since it will usually improve the 质量 of the results. Switching to `none` will also provide minor 速度 ups in the transcription due to less 数量 of 生成 tokens. Notice that setting to none will 产生 **a single chunk with the whole transcription**.

diarize.description: Whether to diarize the 音频 file. Defaults to false. Setting to true will 添加 costs proportional to diarization inference time.

language.description: Language of the 音频 file. If set to null, the language will be automatically 检测. Defaults to null. If translate is selected as the task, the 音频 will be translated to English, regardless of the language selected.

num_speakers.description: Number of speakers in the 音频 file. Defaults to null. If not provided, the number of speakers will be automatically 检测.

prompt.description: 提示词 to use for 生成. Defaults to an empty string.

task.description: Task to perform on the 音频 file. Either transcribe or translate.

merge_chunks.description: Whether to merge consecutive chunks. When enabled, chunks are merged if their combined 时长 does not exceed max_segment_len.

version.description: Version of the model to use. All of the models are the Whisper large variant.

TAPose.description: 生成 characters in T-pose or A-pose 格式, making them easier to rig and animate in 3D software.

bbox_condition.description: This is a controlnet that 控制 the maximum sized of the 生成 model.

enable_creative_mode.description: If enabled, the 生成 will have 增强 generative robustness while ensuring 输出 consistency. This corresponds to `geometry_instruct_mode` being equal to `creative` on the Hyper3D API.

geometry_file_format.description: 格式 of the geometry file. Possible 值: glb, usdz, fbx, obj, stl. 默认 is glb.

hd_texture.description: 启用 增强 texture post-处理 for higher visual fidelity.

is_micro.description: 生成 finer micro-缩放 geometric 细节. Only effective with `tier="Gen-2.5-Extreme-High"`.

material.description: Material type. PBR: physically-based materials with 逼真 lighting. Shaded: baked lighting with no PBR maps. All: both PBR and Shaded variants. None: geometry only with no textures.

prompt.description: A textual 提示词 to guide model 生成. Required for 文本-to-3D 模式.

quality_mesh_option.description:
Combined 质量 and mesh type selection. Quad = 平滑 surfaces, Triangle = 细节 geometry. Maps to `mesh_mode` (Quad/Raw) and `quality_override` (face count) on the Hyper3D API. Valid face counts depend on the selected tier. Up to 1M Triangle is 支持 for tiers Extreme-Low, Low, and Medium. Up to 2M Triangle (as low as 20K Triangle) is 支持 for tiers High and Extreme-High. Auto option will choose the advised options for each tier:
1. Gen-2.5-Minimum: 50K Triangle
2. Gen-2.5-Extreme-Low: 50K Triangle
3. Gen-2.5-Low: 50K Triangle
4. Gen-2.5-Medium: 500K Triangle
5. Gen-2.5-High: 500K Triangle
Gen-2.5-Extreme-High: 1M Triangle.

seed.description: 种子 值 for randomization, ranging from 0 to 65535. 可选.

texture_delight.description: 移除 baked lighting/highlights from the 生成 textures.

texture_mode.description: Texture 生成 质量. When unset, the API picks a 默认 appropriate for the tier.

tier.description: 生成 tier. Higher tiers 产生 more 细节 meshes but cost more. Extreme-High 启用 the highest-细节 模式 and bills at double the base rate. See more info in the [documentation](https://developer.hyper3d.ai/api-specification/rodin-gen2.5#use-gen-2.5-生成-with-following-gen-2.5-tiers). Selecting Gen-2.5-Minimum will automatically configure to a minimum 模式, where 50K Triangle is selected, taking priority over quality_mesh_option.

aspect_ratio.description: 宽高比 to use for training.

audio_normalize.description: Normalize 音频 peak amplitude to a consistent level. Recommended for consistent 音频 levels across the dataset.

audio_preserve_pitch.description: When 音频 时长 doesn't match 视频 时长, stretch/compress 音频 without changing pitch. If disabled, 音频 is trimmed or padded with silence.

auto_scale_input.description: If true, 视频 will be automatically scaled to the target 帧 count and fps. This option has no 效果 on 图像 datasets.

debug_dataset.description: When enabled, the trainer returns a downloadable archive of your preprocessed training data for manual inspection. Use this to verify that your 视频, 图像, and captions were 处理 correctly before committing to a full training run.

first_frame_conditioning_p.description: Probability of conditioning on the first 帧 during training. Higher 值 improve 图生视频 performance.

frame_rate.description: Target 帧率 for the 视频.

generate_audio_in_validation.description: Whether to 生成 音频 in validation samples.

learning_rate.description: Learning rate for optimization. Higher 值 can lead to faster training but may cause overfitting.

number_of_frames.description: 帧数 per training sample. Must satisfy 帧 % 8 == 1 (e.g., 1, 9, 17, 25, 33, 41, 49, 57, 65, 73, 81, 89, 97).

number_of_steps.description: The number of training 步数.

rank.description: The rank of the LoRA adaptation. Higher 值 increase capacity but use more memory.

resolution.description: 分辨率 to use for training. Higher resolutions require more memory.

split_input_duration_threshold.description: The 时长 阈值 in seconds. If a 视频 is longer than this, it will be split into scenes.

split_input_into_scenes.description: If true, 视频 above a certain 时长 阈值 will be split into scenes.

stg_scale.description: STG (Spatio-Temporal Guidance) 缩放. 0.0 禁用 STG. Recommended 值 is 1.0.

training_data_url.description: URL to zip archive with 视频 or 图像. Try to use at least 10 files, although more is better. **支持 视频 格式:** .mp4, .mov, .avi, .mkv **支持 图像 格式:** .png, .jpg, .jpeg Note: The dataset must contain ONLY 视频 OR ONLY 图像 - mixed datasets are not 支持. The archive can also contain 文本 files with captions. Each 文本 file should have the same name as the media file it corresponds to.

trigger_phrase.description: A phrase that will trigger the LoRA style. Will be prepended to captions during training.

validation.description: A list of validation 提示词 to use during training. When providing an 图像, _all_ validation inputs must have an 图像.

validation_aspect_ratio.description: The 宽高比 to use for validation.

validation_frame_rate.description: Target 帧率 for validation 视频.

validation_negative_prompt.description: A 负向提示词 to use for validation.

validation_number_of_frames.description: The 帧数 in validation 视频.

validation_resolution.description: The 分辨率 to use for validation.

with_audio.description: 启用 joint 音频-视频 training. If None (默认), automatically 检测 whether 输入 视频 have 音频. Set to True to force 音频 training, or False to 禁用.

acceleration.description: Acceleration to use for inference. Options are 'none' or 'regular'. Accelerated inference will very slightly affect 输出, but will be significantly faster.

aspect_ratio.description: 生成视频的宽高比。

enable_auto_downsample.description: If true, the model will automatically temporally downsample the 视频 to an appropriate 帧 length for the model, then will 插值 it back to the original 帧 length.

enable_safety_checker.description: 若设为 true，将启用安全检查器。

frames_per_second.description: 帧率 of the 生成 视频. Must be between 5 to 30. Ignored if match_input_frames_per_second is true.

guidance_scale.description: 引导系数 for classifier-free guidance. Higher 值 encourage the model to 生成 图像 closely related to the 文本提示词.

match_input_frames_per_second.description: If true, the 帧率 of the 生成 视频 will match the 输入 视频. If false, the 帧率 will be determined by the frames_per_second parameter.

match_input_num_frames.description: If true, the 帧数 in the 生成 视频 will match the 帧数 in the 输入 视频. If false, the 帧数 will be determined by the num_frames parameter.

negative_prompt.description: 视频生成的负向提示词。

num_frames.description: 帧数 to 生成. Must be between 81 to 241 (inclusive).

num_inference_steps.description: 采样的推理步数。值越大质量越好，但耗时更长。

num_interpolated_frames.description: 帧数 to 插值 between the original 帧. A 值 of 0 means no 插值.

prompt.description: 指导视频生成的文本提示词。

resolution.description: 生成视频的分辨率。

return_frames_zip.description: If true, also return a ZIP file containing all 生成 帧.

sampler.description: Sampler to use for 视频 生成.

seed.description: 用于可复现的随机种子。若为 None 则随机选取。

shift.description: Shift parameter for 视频 生成.

sync_mode.description: 若为 `True`，媒体将以 data URI 形式返回，输出数据不会出现在请求历史中。

temporal_downsample_factor.description: Temporal downsample factor for the 视频. This is an integer 值 that determines how many 帧 to skip in the 视频. A 值 of 0 means no downsampling. For each downsample factor, one upsample factor will automatically be applied.

video.description: URL to the source 视频 file. Required for 局部重绘.

enable_prompt_expansion.description: 是否启用提示词扩展。

enable_safety_checker.description: 是否启用安全检查器。

end_image.description: 可选 keyframe 图像 for the far end of the extension: the final 帧 for forward extension, or the new first 帧 for backward extension.

end_image_strength.description: Conditioning 强度 of the 可选 end keyframe. 1.0 = exact match, lower = more freedom for the model.

extend_direction.description: Direction to extend the 视频. 'forward' continues from the end of the 视频, 'backward' 生成 a new beginning.

frames_per_second.description: 帧率 of the 生成 视频.

generate_audio.description: Whether to 生成 new 音频 for the extension 分割 (crossfaded with the source 音频 at the seam). When disabled, the source 视频's own 音频 追踪 is preserved and the extension stays silent.

guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free 引导系数. The 默认 is tuned for 快速, high-质量 生成.

match_input_fps.description: When enabled, the 输出 FPS matches the source 视频's FPS (rounded to an integer and clamped to the 支持 range) instead of frames_per_second.

negative_prompt.description: The 负向提示词 to steer 生成 away from.

num_context_frames.description: The number of source 帧 used as context/overlap for the extension. Snapped down to the LTX temporal grid (8k+1) and clamped to the 帧 available in the source 视频.

num_frames.description: The 帧数 to 生成 for the extension 分割, including num_context_frames of overlap with the source 视频. The new content 添加 approximately (num_frames - num_context_frames) / frames_per_second seconds. The stable 生成 budget caps the 分辨率 x 帧 volume: at 24 fps roughly 20s at 480p-class, 11s at 720p-class and 5s at 1080p-class; a request above the budget returns a 422 (lower num_frames or use a smaller 分辨率).

num_inference_steps.description: Number of 推理步数. Defaults to 15 and can be increased up to 30.

prompt.description: The 提示词 describing how the 视频 should continue.

resolution.description: 生成视频的尺寸。 'auto' follows the source 视频 尺寸/aspect up to the LTX limits; the source is scaled to the final 尺寸 in the stitched 输出. 尺寸 are 32px-aligned (e.g. 1920x1080 is delivered as 1888x1056). Higher resolutions reduce the maximum stable extension length; lower resolutions can run longer.

seed.description: 用于可复现的随机种子。若为 None 则随机选取。

sync_mode.description: If True, the media is returned as a data URI inline in the response. Useful for short-lived requests and tests.

video.description: The URL of the 视频 to extend.

video_quality.description: The 质量 preset of the 生成 视频.

video_strength.description: Conditioning 强度 of the source context 帧. 1.0 keeps the overlap locked to the source for a seamless transition; lower 值 give the model more freedom.

defaultParamFlag.title: 默认参数标记
defaultParamFlag.description: 控制延长时的参数来源。为 true 时使用本次请求的自定义参数，需提供 continueAt、prompt、style、title；为 false 时使用原音频参数，仅需 audioId，其余参数继承。

model.title: 模型
model.description: 生成所用的 AI 模型版本。所有请求必填。可选：**`V5_5`**：为你独特品味定制的专属模型；**`V5`**：出色的音乐表现力，生成更快；**`V4_5PLUS`**：更丰富的声音与更多创作方式，最长 8 分钟；**`V4_5`**：更聪明的提示词与更快的生成，最长 8 分钟；**`V4_5ALL`**：同 V4.5 的智能提示词与快速生成，最长 8 分钟；**`V4`**：提升人声质量，最长 4 分钟。

You can set the font family name, 尺寸, 颜色, and alignment (left, center, or right), and position the 文本 anywhere on the 图像. ### Fonts Only the font's `name` is used, as a font-family name resolved against the fonts available to the 渲染 (Canvas2D in the browser, sharp/librsvg on the server). The node does not download fonts, so the font's `source`, `url`, and `weight` fields are ignored. #### Applications - Labeling 图像 in an 图像 gallery or database. - Watermarking 图像 for copyright protection. - 添加 custom captions to photographs. - Creating instructional 图像 to guide the reader's view.

history.description: 在当前提示词之前包含的历史对话轮次，按时间正序（最旧在前）。仅 loop 模式可用，plan 模式会拒绝非空历史。每条 Message 含 role（user/assistant/tool）与 content。用于提供临时上下文：例如 few-shot 示例、从其他节点传入的历史聊天，或上游 Agent 的 messages 输出。会插入在系统提示词与新用户提示词之间。若同时设置了 Thread ID，则顺序为：线程加载的历史、此列表、当前提示词。

max_steps.title: 最大步数
max_steps.description: 仅 plan 模式：执行器派发的计划步数上限。限制的是计划规模而非轮数，单步轮数预算由 Max Turns 控制。合理拆分为多步的计划可调高；过度拆分的计划可调低以便尽早失败。

max_tokens.title: 最大 Token 数
max_tokens.description: 每次响应生成 Token 的上限，包括可见输出与推理模型使用的推理/思考 Token。loop 与 plan 模式均适用（plan 模式会把它传给每个步骤执行器与最后的编译阶段）。值越大答案越长、思考空间越足，但成本更高、耗时更长；过小可能截断推理或最终答案。常用值：1024 用于简短回答，8192-16384 用于一般智能体，32k+ 用于长文或深度推理。需在所选模型的上下文窗口内。

max_turns.title: 最大轮数
max_turns.description: 智能体轮数上限——一轮为一次模型调用加其触发的所有工具执行。同时限制 AgentNode 工具循环的迭代次数与服务商内部多轮预算（如 Claude Agent SDK）。长沙箱会话可调高；为避免失控循环可调低。

mode.title: 众数
mode.description:
智能体的运行方式。

• loop：标准工具调用循环。LLM 响应提示词并可迭代调用已连接的工具，直到给出最终答案。适用于聊天、问答与大多数工具类任务。仅 loop 模式使用对话历史、线程与图像/音频输入。
• plan：LLM 先基于目标起草多步任务计划，再按依赖顺序执行（独立步骤并行）。适合步骤清晰的较长结构化任务。plan 模式会忽略/拒绝 Thread ID、Messages（历史）、Images 与 Audio 输入，仅根据提示词中的目标制定计划。

model.title: 模型
model.description: 用于execution的模型。

prompt.title: 提示词
prompt.description: 本次运行的用户消息——智能体要处理的实际问题、任务或内容。会作为最新一轮用户消息追加在系统提示词与对话历史之后。loop 模式下连接的 Image 或 Audio 输入会附在此消息后。plan 模式下作为制定目标的对象。

system.title: 系统
system.description: 定义智能体人设、角色、语气与整体行为的指令。每次运行开始时作为系统消息发送给模型，位于任何历史或用户提示词之前。用于需要始终成立的内容（例如：你是一名资深 Python 评审者，用 Markdown 回复）。每次运行的具体任务放在提示词中。

thread_id.title: 线程 ID
thread_id.description: 持久化对话线程的标识。仅 loop 模式可用，plan 模式会拒绝 thread_id。设置后，智能体会在本轮之前加载该 ID 下存储的全部历史消息，并在结束后把新的用户消息、助手回复与工具消息保存回该线程——让智能体在多次运行与共享同一 ID 的多个节点之间拥有长期记忆。留空表示无状态一次性调用。可用 Create Thread 节点生成新 ID，或从上游传入同一字符串以延续已有对话。

nodetool.code.Code.title: 代码
nodetool.code.Code.description:
在沙箱环境中执行原生 JavaScript。可用 API：fetch()、workspace.read/write/list/readBytes/writeBytes/stat/mkdir/remove/copy/move/root()、getSecret()、sleep()、progress()、crypto.digest/hmac/randomUUID/getRandomValues、format.number/date/relativeTime/list、toBase64/fromBase64/toHex/fromHex、parallelMap，以及由服务端平台工具支撑的 `nodetool` 对象模型（workflows、assets、jobs 等）——调用 nodetool.capabilities() 可查看当前生效的能力。基于工具的调用会消耗费用（媒体生成、工作流运行）并访问网络；每个工具会独立执行权限校验。动态输入通过 `inputs` 对象传入；返回一个对象来定义输出。
关键词：代码、JavaScript、函数、脚本、动态

allow_host_filesystem.title: 允许访问宿主文件系统
allow_host_filesystem.description: 允许 workspace.* 访问进程可读的任意路径（会展开 ~），而不仅限于工作区。默认关闭——宿主模式下可能读取到凭据文件。仅当节点确需在工作区之外操作时才开启。

allow_local_network.title: 允许访问本地网络
allow_local_network.description: 允许 fetch() 访问 localhost 与私有 IP 段。默认关闭——沙箱代码不受信任，默认启用 SSRF 防护。仅当节点确需访问本机或本网络的服务时才开启。

code.title: 代码
code.description: 要执行的 JavaScript 代码。动态输入通过 `inputs` 对象传入。可用 API：fetch(url, options)、workspace.read/write/list/readBytes/writeBytes/stat/mkdir/remove/copy/move/root，workspace.stat(path) 返回 {exists, size, isDirectory, isFile, isSymlink, modifiedMs, createdMs, accessedMs}，nodetool.secrets.get(name)（未设置时抛错；设置了 `secrets` 时仅限其中列出的名称）、getSecret(name)、sleep(ms)、progress(percent, message)、crypto.randomUUID/getRandomValues/digest/hmac、format.number/date/relativeTime/list、toBase64/fromBase64/toHex/fromHex。各类库——CSV、HTML、XML、XLSX、YAML、zip、日期、diff——以沙箱包形式提供：在 `packages` 中声明后，在顶部 `import` 即可。fetch、sleep、workspace、getSecret、format、已导入包的调用，以及 crypto.digest/hmac 需 await；其余同步执行。并发调用会并行运行：用 Promise.all 或 parallelMap(items, fn, concurrency) 来并发 fetch。`nodetool` 对象模型在宿主支持时暴露平台工具（nodetool.workflows、nodetool.assets 等）——nodetool.capabilities() 返回当前生效的命名空间；其余环境下调用其方法会抛错并指出缺少的工具。`state` 对象可在流式调用之间持久保存。返回一个对象——其键会成为输出句柄。

max_response_mb.title: 响应大小上限
max_response_mb.description: 单个 fetch() 允许读取的响应体大小上限（MB），超出即中止。

packages.title: 包
packages.description: 本段代码允许导入的沙箱包，以说明符或 {specifier, resolvedPackVersion, contentDigest} 对象形式给出，例如 ["@acme/geo"]。沙箱只会解析此处列出的内容；其他 `import` 一律失败，动态 `import()`/`require()` 不可用。

secrets.title: 密钥
secrets.description: 本段代码允许读取的密钥名称，例如 ["NOTION_API_KEY"]。nodetool.secrets.get(name) 与 getSecret(name) 会拒绝读取任何其他名称，使访问单一服务的节点无法读取其他服务的凭据。留空表示不限定范围——可读取整个密钥库，与该属性引入之前的旧节点行为一致。

top_k.description: Reduces sampling to the k most likely tokens.

additional_config.description: 进阶 configuration options as JSON string. Options include: 'disable_links' (移除 hyperlinks), 'keep_pageheader_in_output' (preserve headers), 'keep_pagefooter_in_output' (preserve footers), 'filter_blank_pages' (skip empty pages), 'drop_repeated_text' (移除 duplicates), and layout/table 处理 thresholds. Full list at: https://documentation.datalab.to/api-reference/marker

block_correction_prompt.description: 可选 文本提示词 to guide 输出 improvements. Use this to specify formatting preferences or 提取 requirements, e.g., '提取 all dates in YYYY-MM-DD 格式' or 'Keep all tables in their original structure'

disable_image_extraction.description: Skip 提取 图像 from the PDF. By 默认, 图像 are 提取 and returned as base64-encoded data in the 图像 field

disable_ocr_math.description: 禁用 recognition of inline mathematical expressions during OCR. By 默认, math expressions are 检测 and can be formatted as LaTeX

file.description: 输入 file. Must be one of: .pdf, .doc, .docx, .ppt, .pptx, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp

force_ocr.description: Force OCR on all pages even if 文本 is extractable. By 默认, Marker automatically uses OCR only when needed (e.g., scanned PDFs). 启用 this if you see garbled or incorrect 文本 in the 输出

format_lines.description: 检测 and 格式 inline mathematical expressions and 文本 styles (bold, italic, etc.) in the 输出. Useful for documents with mathematical notation

include_metadata.description: Include 细节 metadata and JSON structure in the 输出. When enabled, returns json_data (hierarchical document structure with bounding boxes) and metadata (page stats, table of contents). When disabled (默认), only returns markdown to reduce response 尺寸

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to 处理. Cannot be specified if page_range is set - these parameters are mutually exclusive

mode.description: 处理 模式 affecting 速度 and 质量. '快速': lowest latency, preserves most positional information. 'balanced': same as using use_llm. '准确': highest 质量, slowest, preserves least positional information

page_range.description: Page range to parse, comma separated like 0,5-10,20. Example: '0,2-4' will 处理 pages 0, 2, 3, and 4. Cannot be specified if max_pages is set - these parameters are mutually exclusive

page_schema.description: Structured 提取: Provide a JSON Schema to 提取 specific fields from your document. When provided, the model 提取 only the fields you define and returns them in the 'extraction_schema_json' 输出 field (as a JSON string containing your 提取 data plus citation fields showing which parts of the document were used). The 'markdown' and 'json_data' fields will still contain the full document conversion. Example: {"type":"object","properties":{"invoice_number":{"type":"string"},"total":{"type":"number"}}}. See: https://documentation.datalab.to/docs/recipes/structured-提取/api-overview. Increases cost by 50%

save_checkpoint.description: Save 处理 checkpoint for iterative refinement. Checkpoints can be used with the Marker 提示词 API to apply custom rules without re-parsing the entire document. Only useful for 进阶 workflows

segmentation_schema.description: JSON Schema for document 分割. Define 分割 names and descriptions to 识别 and 提取 different sections of the document (e.g., 'Executive Summary', 'Financial Data'). Useful for splitting long documents by section. See: https://documentation.datalab.to/api-reference/marker

skip_cache.description: Bypass the server-side cache and force re-处理. By 默认, identical requests are cached to save time and cost. 启用 this to get fresh results

strip_existing_ocr.description: 移除 embedded OCR 文本 layer from the PDF and re-run OCR from scratch. Some PDFs have low-质量 embedded OCR 文本; this option lets you regenerate it. Ignored if force_ocr is enabled

use_llm.description: Use an LLM to significantly improve accuracy for tables, forms, inline math, and layout 检测. This merges tables across pages, handles 复杂 layouts, and 提取 form 值. Will increase 处理 time

render_factor.description: The 默认值 of 35 has been carefully chosen and should work -ok- for most scenarios (but probably won't be the -best-). This determines 分辨率 at which the 颜色 portion of the 图像 is 渲染. Lower 分辨率 will 渲染 faster, and 颜色 also tend to look more vibrant. Older and lower 质量 图像 in particular will generally benefit by lowering the 渲染 factor. Higher 渲染 factors are often better for higher 质量 图像, but the 颜色 may get slightly washed out.
